summary.businessPurpose: Enable distributed multi-agent coordination for horizontal scaling, workload distribution, and isolated task execution across vessel fleet

components.currentBehavior: Entry point for delegation - validates target, collects impulses, serializes pointers, spawns docker exec, manages ACP connection, relays events, tracks status
components.desiredBehavior: Same functionality with added: retry logic for docker exec, timeout on permission requests, version negotiation in handshake, impulse ID validation
components.gap: Missing: retry (3 attempts), 30s permission timeout, version check, impulse validation

components.currentBehavior: Strips content from impulses to create pointer-only representation (95% size reduction)
Local-first resolution with fallback to host via acp_request_impulse_content
components.desiredBehavior: Same with added: LRU cache with mtime-based invalidation, circuit breaker for MCP
components.gap: Missing: caching layer, circuit breaker pattern

components.currentBehavior: Subscribes to SDK events and relays to ACP protocol via connection.sessionUpdate
components.desiredBehavior: Same with added: unsubscribe on session close, event buffer limits, delivery guarantees
components.gap: Missing: cleanup handlers, memory leak prevention, event buffering

components.currentBehavior: Forwards permission requests to host, blocks execution until approval (no timeout)
components.desiredBehavior: Same with 30s timeout and auto-reject on timeout

components.currentBehavior: Registers vessel metadata in SurrealDB using string concatenation (SQL injection risk)
components.desiredBehavior: Use parameterized queries with input validation
components.gap: CRITICAL: SQL injection vulnerability, no input validation

components.currentBehavior: Updates impulse in session memory with throttling logic
components.desiredBehavior: Same with atomic transactions and write-ahead log
components.gap: Missing: transaction support, WAL for durability

dataFlow: acp_delegate (entry) → ImpulseSerializer (strip content) → buildPromptWithImpulses (XML wrap) → Docker Exec (transport) → ACP Handshake (protocol) → ImpulseResolver (local-first) → Agent.prompt (execution) → Event Relay (status tracking) → updateRemoteSessionStatus (throttled updates) → Tool Result (exit)

architecturalBoundaries.coupling: Medium (protocol-based, but SDK bugs impact functionality)

architecturalBoundaries.risk: No retry logic, no health check

architecturalBoundaries.coupling: Medium (file path convention hardcoded, JSON format)
Tight (direct SDK event handling, no abstraction)
architecturalBoundaries.risk: No delivery guarantee, no buffering, no reconnection

criticalRisks.impact: Attacker can delete entire vessel registry
Remote agent hangs indefinitely on host crash
Incompatible OpenCode versions cause silent failures
Transient failures (container restart) cause permanent delegation failure

reusablePatterns.description: Try local resolution first (fast), fallback to remote fetch (slow)
Limit non-terminal updates to max frequency, always allow terminal updates
Subscribe to local events, relay to remote protocol

functional: Local resolution succeeds for file pointers
Fallback to host succeeds when local fails

security: Permission approval required for sensitive operations
reliability: Retry logic for docker exec (3 attempts)
Event subscription cleanup on session close
dataIntegrity: Impulse ID validation (all IDs must exist)
